title: Roll20 account data breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Roll20, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Roll20 says fewer than 1% of its users were affected. It claims over 15 million players, so that is up to about 150,000 accounts on one gaming site, worldwide.
who_is_affected: Roll20 users who got the company's warning email. Their names, emails and password hashes were involved, and for some the last 4 digits of a saved card.

known.text: An unauthorized third party got into Roll20's system on the evening of Nov 16; Roll20 blocked the access.
Fewer than 1% of Roll20 users were affected, and each was emailed.
Names, email addresses and salted bcrypt password hashes were involved.
Some users with a saved card had the last 4 digits involved; full card numbers were not.

not_known.text: How many accounts, as a number.
Whether any data was copied. Roll20 says it found no evidence of it.
Why Roll20 believes the attack was AI-assisted.
